faqs.q: Which regions does Vidhi Transport serve?
faqs.a: Vidhi Transport serves industrial corridors across Gujarat and Maharashtra, including Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Ankleshwar, Jhagadia, Saykha, Panoli, Dahej, Sachin, Kadodara, Vapi, Umergaon, Daman, Bhiwandi, Rabale, Navi Mumbai, Ambernath, JNPT and Mundra.

faqs.q: What is the difference between full truckload and part truckload transport?
faqs.a: Full truckload provides a dedicated vehicle for one consignment. Part truckload consolidates smaller consignments so a customer does not need to reserve the entire vehicle.

faqs.q: What types of industrial cargo does Vidhi Transport handle?
faqs.a: We coordinate movement for packaged chemical drums, carboys, IBCs, pharmaceutical cartons, industrial packaging, raw materials, finished goods and machinery, subject to cargo documentation and handling requirements.

faqs.q: Does Vidhi Transport provide shipment reports and MIS reports?
faqs.a: Yes. Shipment reporting and MIS reports are available to help customers monitor freight movement and operational activity.

faqs.q: Does Vidhi Transport provide reverse logistics for rejected goods?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate cost-conscious return movement for rejected goods and other reverse-logistics requirements, subject to the cargo and route.

faqs.q: Does Vidhi Transport support other transport booking and last-mile delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. Where operationally available, we can store finished goods and coordinate onward booking or last-mile delivery according to the destination and timeline.

faqs.q: How can I request a freight quotation?
faqs.a: Call Vidhi Transport, use the website enquiry form, or send the pickup location, destination, cargo details and preferred dispatch date through WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Where can I verify Vidhi Transport's credentials?
faqs.a: Visit our Credentials page for information about the Go Green initiative, Indian Banks' Association approval and ISO certification, or contact us for current supporting documents.
